name: outcome
description: Turn a requirement, idea, or transcript into ONE outcome doc per capability. Human decisions enter verbatim and first (a protected §0 TLDR a founder reads in 60 seconds: outcome line, rules as bullets, how-we'll-know); the agent derives invariants, mechanism with file:line evidence, Given/When/Then acceptance, and build phases. Includes a review mode that applies the framework as a code-verified rubric to docs authored elsewhere, and an arm mode that turns acceptance rows into red tests before building.
